definitions.gloss: plain clothes, casual clothes, civilian clothes
definitions.explanation: Ordinary everyday clothing as opposed to a uniform, work clothes, or official attire.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{私服|しふく}で{来|き}た。
examples.english: I came in plain clothes today.

examples.japanese: {休|やす}みの{日|ひ}は{私服|しふく}で{過|す}ごす。
examples.english: I spend days off in casual clothes.

examples.japanese: この{学校|がっこう}は{制服|せいふく}がないので、{生徒|せいと}は{毎日|まいにち}{私服|しふく}で{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: This school has no uniform, so students attend in their own clothes every day.

notes:
{私服|しふく} refers to personal, everyday clothing worn outside of official duties or school.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {私服|しふく}で{通|かよ}う: to commute in plain clothes
- {私服|しふく}{警官|けいかん}: plainclothes police officer

CONTRAST:
- {制服|せいふく}: uniform (school, work)
- {作業着|さぎょうぎ}: work clothes
- {正装|せいそう}: formal attire
